svg.aria-label: From render resolution to the finished frame
svg.title: From render resolution to the finished frame
svg.text: From render resolution to the finished frame
The same part of one frame at each step, rendered at 50 % per axis. The 3D scene is rendered small and scaled up, so it
softens; the UI is drawn after that, at the output resolution, so its text stays sharp.
at 50 % per axis: 25 % of the pixels
